# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary architecture and analysis documents generated during assessment.

## Available Documents

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - High-level application architecture and component relationship diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - External dependency map grouped by functional category.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - API endpoint inventory and service communication contract details.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Data and persistence architecture including entity model and ownership boundaries.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration source inventory, profiles, and sensitive settings overview.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Core business workflows, decision points, and sequence diagram.
